Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa strike two important terrorist bases in Diafarabé and Menaka
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko This Saturday, October 17, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 40 km north-east of the city of Diafarabé, a major base housing several terrorist elements as well as war and logistics equipment.

Mali.title: Mali: Prayer Sessions and Sacrifices in Kati in Memory of Civilian and Military Casualties
Mali.summary: PRAYER AND SACRIFICE IN MEMORY OF CIVILIAN and MILITARY VICTIMS This Sunday, October 18, 2026, in Kati, the Minister of Religious Affairs, Worship and Customs, Dr. Mahamadou KONE, took part in a prayer and sacrifice session organized by the military hierarchy in memory of the civilian and military victims of the crisis in our country . The ceremony took place in the presence of Major General Oumar DIARRA, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, military leaders and the families of the victims, gathered for this moment of meditation, solidarity and spiritual communion .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strikes two bases housing terrorist groups in Diarafabé and Menaka
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 18 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, successfully carried out, on Saturday, October 17, 2026, strikes against two bases housing terrorist elements and war and logistics equipment, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, announced the General Staff of the Armed Forces . According to the press release, the exploitation of precise information made it possible to locate a large base about 40 km northeast of the city of Diafarabé.

Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 18 (ANP)- During the first half of October, the security situation remained generally calm and under control.
